summary: Frontend-only test of the pre-selection bug fix on /order-collection-v2. Login via Supabase (agent gdeintinis) works. Customer Detail → 'Ordine' tap navigates to /order-collection-v2?customerId=<uuid> correctly (URL is right). HOWEVER the BUG FIX IS NOT WORKING: on the resulting Step 1 screen the customer is NOT pre-selected (no highlighted row, radio remains off) and the 'Avanti' button stays DISABLED (pointerEvents:none, bg:#9CA3AF). A separate but related root cause was captured on direct navigation to /order-collection-v2?customerId=<uuid>: the customer list is EMPTY because loadInitialData throws 'invalid input syntax for type uuid: ""' — user.id is empty at fetch time (Supabase session not yet hydrated), so fetchCustomers is called with an empty string. That same race can explain the tap-through failure if params.customerId is read before customers finally populate — but in tap-through the useEffect deps include `customers`, so it should fire once the list loads. No '[order-v2] Cliente pre-selezionato...' log was captured in either case. Regression checks partially blocked: direct 'Raccolta Ordine' from Dashboard also shows empty customer list on first mount (same auth-race error), which is a NEW regression to investigate.

ui_bugs.issue: Customer NOT pre-selected when arriving from Customer Detail → 'Ordine' tap. URL correctly carries ?customerId=<uuid> (e.g. 8984d26d-7717-4489-a11a-5acb19f1ffdf for SILVIA) and the customer list DOES load with 20 clients (SILVIA visible at the top), but no row is highlighted and 'Avanti' remains disabled (backgroundColor rgb(156,163,175), pointerEvents:none). Expected: SILVIA row selected, Avanti enabled.

On DIRECT navigation to /order-collection-v2?customerId=<uuid> (page reload or direct link), console shows: '[V2] Error loading data: {code: 22P02, message: invalid input syntax for type uuid: ""}'. Cause: `fetchCustomers(user?.id || '', ...)` runs with user.id === '' because Supabase auth store is not yet hydrated at first render. Customer list ends up EMPTY → pre-selection guard `customers.length > 0` never becomes true. Fix hint: gate loadInitialData on a valid `user?.id` (not just vbLoading), or short-circuit fetchCustomers when id is empty.

Same auth-race: opening /order-collection-v2 directly (no customerId) after Dashboard tap yields empty customer list on first mount due to the same UUID error. User must reload or come back to see clients.

integration_issues.issue: Params correctly propagated in URL; new useEffect at lines 336-354 is not producing a selected state (no '[order-v2] Cliente pre-selezionato...' log observed). Possible causes to investigate: 1) params.customerId in expo-router web may be received as `string | string[]`; if it's an array Array.find compares against a non-string; 2) selectedCustomer might briefly be truthy then reset by another effect (e.g. reloadForForeignToggle re-render); 3) fetchCustomers filtered list may exclude SILVIA under some role/branch condition (unlikely since Clienti tab lists her).

react_native_issues.issue: Console error on customer detail screen: 'Unexpected text node: . A text node cannot be a child of a <View>.' Indicates an unwrapped string/whitespace between JSX siblings inside a View.

Web console warns: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents.' Non-blocking, but should be cleaned up (multiple files use shadowColor/shadowOffset and <View pointerEvents=...>).

action_items: URGENT (HIGH): Fix auth race in order-collection-v2 loadInitialData — do not call fetchCustomers with empty user.id. Add guard `if (!user?.id) return;` at start of loadInitialData, and add `user?.id` to the useEffect deps so it re-runs once the auth store hydrates. Without this, ANY entry to /order-collection-v2 on a cold navigation fails silently with the 22P02 UUID error and shows an empty customer list.

HIGH: After fixing #1, re-verify pre-selection. If still broken, log `params.customerId` type and value inside the pre-selection useEffect and coerce to string: `const targetId = Array.isArray(params.customerId) ? params.customerId[0] : params.customerId;` before Array.find.

MEDIUM: Reproduce the missing '[order-v2] Cliente pre-selezionato...' console log. If the log doesn't appear even after auth fix, add `console.log('[order-v2] effect params:', params.customerId, 'customers:', customers.length, 'isLoading:', isLoading, 'draftLoaded:', draftLoaded, 'selectedCustomer:', !!selectedCustomer)` at the top of the useEffect for one iteration to diagnose which guard fails.
LOW: Fix 'Unexpected text node' warning in customer/[id].tsx.
LOW: Migrate deprecated shadow* style props to boxShadow and move pointerEvents to style prop (react-native-web deprecations).
critical_code_review_comments: order-collection-v2.tsx loadInitialData does NOT guard for empty user.id. `fetchCustomers(user?.id || '', ...)` sends '' to Supabase, which rejects it as invalid uuid. This is a real production risk on any deep-link/refresh scenario.

The new pre-selection useEffect logic (336-354) looks correct in isolation, but its outcome depends on a populated customers[] which is currently blocked by the auth-race bug above. The two issues compound.
params.customerId is typed as `string | undefined` via the generic, but at runtime expo-router web may return `string | string[]`. Consider defensive coercion.

rca_of_issue: Primary RCA: loadInitialData in /app/frontend/app/order-collection-v2.tsx (~line 616-628) invokes `fetchCustomers(user?.id || '', user?.role || 'agent', user?.branchId)` inside a useEffect whose only dependency is `vbLoading`. On cold navigation to the screen (both from Customer Detail tap and direct URL), the Supabase auth store `user` object is briefly `null`/empty before hydration completes, causing `fetchCustomers` to be called with an empty string, which Supabase/PostgreSQL rejects with error code 22P02 ('invalid input syntax for type uuid'). The catch block then finishes loading with an empty customers array and isLoading=false. Because the pre-selection useEffect (lines 336-354) requires `customers.length > 0`, it never satisfies its guard and setSelectedCustomer is never called → 'Avanti' stays disabled. Mitigation: (a) guard `if (!user?.id) return;` inside loadInitialData; (b) add `user?.id` to the useEffect dependency list so it re-runs once auth hydrates; (c) also verify defensive string coercion for params.customerId. Repro steps: 1) login as agent gdeintinis, 2) open Clienti tab and open SILVIA, 3) tap 'Ordine' → observe URL /order-collection-v2?customerId=8984d26d-... but Step 1 shows no highlighted customer and 'Avanti' is disabled.
